programs.title: American Masters
programs.sub_title: W.E.B. Du Bois: Rebel With a Cause
programs.desc: Exploring the life and legacy of Black civil rights pioneer W.E.B. Du Bois, including how he transcended the social constraints of the early 20th century and worked to elevate the lives of Black people worldwide.

programs.title: Marked Man: Martin Luther King and the FBI
programs.desc: Martin Luther King Jr. helps drive change in the United States in the face of bitter opposition, not least from opponents within the U.S. government; King is subjected to a fierce campaign of intimidation by J. Edgar Hoover's FBI.

programs.title: Nature Cat
programs.sub_title: The Nature Nap Dilemma; Captain Nature Cat's Wild River Adventure
programs.desc: The gang goes looking for their Nature Nap hammock; Nature Cat and his pals help an oyster named Elroy get back home.

programs.title: Lyla in the Loop
programs.sub_title: Oaty Zappers on Ice; The California Loops
programs.desc: The Loops go on a scavenger hunt around the supermarket to solve clues to get tickets to "Oaty Zappers on Ice"; Lyla tries to act older so she can hang out with her cousin.

programs.title: Arthur
programs.sub_title: Arthur the Wrecker; Arthur and the True Francine
programs.desc: Arthur scrambles to fix his mother's computer before she finds out he broke it; Francine gets blamed when Muffy cheats on a math test.

programs.title: Odd Squad
programs.sub_title: Mid-day in the Garden of Good and Odd; Failure to Lunch
programs.desc: The agents turn to Odd Todd for help when things in town get covered in jam; agents have a hard time relaxing at lunch.
